title: HSI curve-shape corrections (§4.46)
simLoop: Six suitability arms that were monotone or hard-step now use hump / threshold-slope forms already present in the composition set. Binder burial reads longshore transport divergence; crust moisture peaks low–moderate.
gameLoop: A millimetre across MHW no longer zeros an upland stand; wet sand is no longer the crust optimum; dune binders want moderate burial, not stillness; splash pioneers peak mid-exposure.
notebookSeed: The wet band is no longer the best place for every living thing — and crossing the tide line does not kill a meadow in one tick.
tierO: no owner-only question — curve shapes are CI-judged against named edge cases; C-011 taste residual unchanged.
